Day 14 (old art) - October 2015 (age 12)

so my classmate asked me to do a ghetto Rapunzel design and apparently what was considered "ghetto" to my 12 yo self was short clothes, tattoos and a lip ring

funny af that like 6 years later she'd proudly wear all of those things :P

also a bit of Phandom peaking through whoopsie
